title: More employees say they get enough training. More of them multitask through it.
subtitle: Share of US employees surveyed by TalentLMS each year who say each statement applies to them

series.label: Received enough training from their employer

notes: Separate surveys each year. The 2025 survey, fielded in September 2025, covered 1,000 US full-time employees who had received training from their current employer in the previous 12 months.
